entities.summary: Leo Rwabwogo was a Ugandan boxer, who won two Olympic medals during his career as an amateur in the flyweight division. He won a bronze medal at the 1968 Summer Olympics in Mexico City before winning a silver medal at the 1972 Summer Olympics in Munich. He also won a silver medal at the 1970 British Commonwealth Games in Edinburgh.
